text:
jordan.partners: Quick check — we need a SKU readiness + handoff mapping for the Gaudi + MI300 wave. Goal: one single table that tells marketplace, SI, and launch comms who owns each artifact and embargo window.

kevin-hw: I can own the HW validation artifacts (firmware freeze, kernel tag). Need vendor contact list from partnerships.

maya.prod: Add me for marketplace certs and doc packaging. We need the SKU tag format: `redwood-gaudi-v1` style or do vendors want their SKU preserved?

alex.devex: For devex templates/quickstarts I need a list of canonical config snippets and a minimum test matrix (seq_len, bs, mem). Prefer small JSON snippets we can embed.

jordan.partners: Good. Immediate ask: can we land a draft mapping by EOD Friday? Also callout: fallback routing story — if MI300 capacity drops, which SKUs fallback to H200/B200 variants? That needs to be explicit.

kevin-hw: Firmware freeze risk: vendor indicated a microcode update hitting late May. If that lands, we may need to embargo press + marketplace tile until we re-run certs. I'll put dates in the doc.

maya.prod: Proposed cert artifact list I want in the mapping: (1) signed firmware image hash, (2) validated kernel tag, (3) marketplace tile JSON, (4) SI install image + test bench script, (5) release notes/compat matrix.

alex.devex: For test bench script, can we standardize on a small runner? e.g.:
```
# quick perf smoke
./run_bench --model llama2-13b --seq 2048 --batch 1 --quant q4
```
That plus a failure threshold (p50 < 120ms/token) would allow automated pass/fail in CI.

sam-oncall: We also need an ops play for capacity fallthrough. Suggest automatic routing rule: `if region_capacity(mi300) < 20% then route->gaudi-compatible or h200-fallback` with explicit latency SLO droppoints. Need signoff from reliability.

jordan.partners: Love it. Let's map owners: Kevin -> HW artifacts; Maya -> marketplace packaging + tile; Alex -> devex snippets + CI jobs; Sam -> ops playbook + routing rules; Jordan -> communications embargo/press queue.

kevin-hw: Vendor contacts: NVIDIA rep is `maria@nvidia` (firmware PM), Habana rep is `raj@habana`, AMD rep is `lucas@amd`. I'll slack intros after this thread.

maya.prod: On marketplace tile: add a "fallback guidance" section so customers see expected alternate SKUs during regional outages. Also add recommended default routing policy snippet for customers using dedicated capacity.

alex.devex: I'll draft example `.yaml` for the marketplace tile and a devx quickstart folder. Example snippet: 
```json
{
  "sku": "rw-gaudi-48g",
  "quant": "q4_0",
  "recommended_bs": 1
}
```

ci-bot: CI job created: `marketplace-cert/gaudi-mi300/smoke` (status: queued)

kevin-hw: Quick blocker: Gaudi vendor asked for a pre-cert checklist — they want power/thermal numbers for our lab image. Can infra tag an image with `lab-power-profile-v2`?

sam-oncall: tagging infra ticket now. ticket: INFRA-4821.

jordan.partners: Action items recap:
- Kevin: vendor intros + firmware freeze dates (owner)
- Maya: draft marketplace tile + fallback guidance (owner)
- Alex: devex snippets + CI job templates (owner)
- Sam: ops routing playbook + infra ticket follow-up (owner)
- Jordan: draft comms + embargo windows and press handoff doc (owner)

jordan.partners: Deadline: draft mapping into a single Google sheet by EOD Friday (I put a proposed template in #partnerships drive). If anyone expects delays, flag now.

kevin-hw: Might need +48h if firmware dates change — will update by tomorrow morning.

maya.prod: Fine, I'll aim for Thursday EOD so product can review Friday AM.

alex.devex: I'll start the quickstart and CI templates today, PR by Thursday.

sam-oncall: Ops playbook draft by Friday noon.

jordan.partners: Great. I'll put a 30-min sync on Friday 10:30 to walk the sheet and agree owners. @kevin-hw @maya.prod @alex.devex @sam-oncall : please accept if calendar works. :calendar:   

kevin-hw: Accepted.

maya.prod: Accepted.

alex.devex: Accepted.

sam-oncall: Accepted.

jordan.partners: Thanks — attaching a quick checklist to this thread for reference:
```
- SKU mapping table (sku -> marketplace_tile -> owner)
- Cert artifacts checklist (firmware hash, kernel tag, ci job, smoke logs)
- Fallback routing rules (policy + SLO)
- Press/embargo windows (dates + contacts)
- SI handoff checklist (installer, testbench, runbook)
```

kevin-hw: I'll post vendor intro DMs after lunch.

maya.prod: I'll populate the tile template and share link in the sheet.

alex.devex: Will open PR for templates.

sam-oncall: INFRA-4821 updated with `lab-power-profile-v2`.

jordan.partners: Closing here for now — ping in thread with updates. :thumbsup:
